name: Numbl
description: Open-source MATLAB-compatible computing environment that runs .m files in the browser and on the command line; early stage (with Dan Fortunato).

name: mip
description: Package manager for MATLAB and numbl: dependencies, precompiled MEX binaries, and path management; early stage (with Dan Fortunato).

name: Neurosift
description: Browser-based visualization of NWB (Neurodata Without Borders) files and interactive exploration of the DANDI Archive, EMBER Archive, and OpenNeuro (with the CatalystNeuro team).

name: Figpack
description: Python package for interactive scientific visualizations as self-contained HTML bundles: portable, reproducible, and suitable for long-term archiving.

name: Stan Playground
description: Browser-based editor and runtime for Stan models: edit, compile, run, and analyze results with no local installation (with Brian Ward and Jeff Soules).

name: DANDI AI Notebooks
description: AI-powered chat assistant and automated notebook generator for exploring neurophysiology datasets in the DANDI Archive (with Ben Dichter, Ryan Ly, and Oliver Ruebel).

name: Isosplit
description: Non-parametric clustering with no adjustable parameters, based on Hartigan's dip statistic and isotonic regression.

name: MountainSort
description: Spike sorting software built on isosplit clustering.

name: LINDI
description: Cloud-friendly file format and Python library for NWB data, compatible with HDF5 and Zarr and designed for linking to remote datasets (with the NWB team).

name: simple_ans
description: Simple, efficient lossless compression of integer datasets via Asymmetric Numeral Systems.

name: NWB Assistant
description: Experimental AI chat assistant for navigating NWB documentation.

name: Stan Assistant
description: Experimental AI chat assistant for Stan, with access to the Stan User's Guide.

name: Neurosift chat
description: Experimental AI chat assistant for exploring the DANDI Archive and OpenNeuro.

name: Spurious Discovery Tests
description: Synthetic experiments probing whether large language models avoid false discoveries when analyzing datasets with no underlying signal.

name: minicline
description: Command-line and Python interface for software engineering tasks with large language models.

name: MCMC Monitor
description: Real-time tracking and diagnostic visualization of Stan MCMC runs in the browser (with Jeff Soules).

name: nbfiddle
description: Web-based Jupyter notebook interface using browser storage, designed for self-contained analysis notebooks with remote data sources.

name: SpikeInterface
description: Unified Python framework for spike sorting and electrophysiology analysis; part of the original team.

name: FINUFFT
description: Fast, parallel library for the nonuniform fast Fourier transform on CPU and GPU; co-developed the original version with Alex Barnett.

name: Benchcompress
description: Benchmarking framework for compression algorithms on scientific data arrays.

name: Remfile
description: File-like object for reading remote files over HTTP, optimized for h5py.
